headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 20, 2026**
article:
The Minnesota Twins suffered a blowout loss to the Cleveland Guardians, with Petey Halpin leading the Twins' offense. In other news, the New York Yankees secured a 5-8 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Jazz Chisholm Jr. leading the Pirates' offense. The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Toronto Blue Jays 7-1, with Nick Fortes contributing to the win.

Several players are dealing with injuries, including Will Smith, who was transferred to the 60-day injured list due to neck inflammation. The Athletics placed Joshua Kuroda-Grauer on the 10-day injured list after ruptured testicle surgery. Mark Leiter Jr. was also placed on the 15-day injured list due to right hip impingement.

The Los Angeles Dodgers acquired Seth Halvorsen from the Colorado Rockies in a trade. The Athletics traded Aaron Civale to the Chicago Cubs for Aiden Moffett. The Baltimore Orioles acquired Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals for cash. The Tampa Bay Rays traded Trey Pooser to the St. Louis Cardinals.

top_news.title: **Twins Fall to Guardians in Blowout**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins suffered a 13-4 loss to the Cleveland Guardians, with Petey Halpin leading the Twins' offense with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 3 RBIs. Tanner Bibee earned the win for the Guardians, pitching 6.0 innings with 5 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Yankees in 5-8 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-8 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Jazz Chisholm Jr. leading the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, 2 home runs, and 5 RBIs. Wilber Dotel impressed on the mound for the Pirates with 3.0 scoreless innings, 5 strikeouts, and 1 hit allowed.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Blue Jays 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Nick Fortes leading the offense. Fortes hit a home run on a fly ball to left center field, contributing to his 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Rally Past Orioles in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox edged the Baltimore Orioles 6-5 in a closely contested matchup. Christian Encarnacion-Strand led the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Shut Out by Yankees in Thrilling Match**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 0-0 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, marking a close contest.

top_news.title: **Orioles' Shutout Bid Falls Short in Boston**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 0-0 win over the Baltimore Orioles, handing the visitors their loss.

top_news.title: **Dodgers' Will Smith Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Dodgers catcher Will Smith has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to neck inflammation.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Acquire Halvorsen in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers have acquired RHP Seth Halvorsen from the Colorado Rockies in exchange for RHP Nick Frasso and OF Landyn Vidourek.
